column3: The Hebrew says “from the mouth of Jeremiah” and narrates issuing the proclamation as a separate action; BSB says “spoken through Jeremiah” and connects it with “to send.”
The Hebrew explicitly says he should go up to Jerusalem; BSB says he should go to Jerusalem.
The Hebrew makes the local men the active subjects of assisting him; BSB uses “be assisted.”
The Hebrew says they arose to go up and build; BSB says they prepared to go up and rebuild.
The Hebrew describes support through their hands; BSB says they supported them.
The Hebrew says “the house”; BSB says “the temple.”
The Hebrew says Cyrus brought them out by the hand of the treasurer; BSB says he had them brought out.
The Hebrew does not explicitly repeat silver for the final twenty-nine objects; BSB supplies “silver.”
